items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: And that was only with Carl Bells. He had one shiny block... I was doing a flash when they were redhead happy when he's worked at the old Lyric, Lyric Theater.

ctx.x: But when did that start, do you think?

Oh, I wouldn't know how that's. Well, the old-time drummers, no, they didn't take a whole solo. I don't remember none of them taking a whole, but they took breaks. Make a break on the ending. In some numbers, them days you might have some numbers called for a four-bar break, a drummer running there. But most of the endings of the drummer are running there. Now, all those men I know used to take plenty of drum solos. I was doing a flash when they were redhead happy when he's worked at the old Lyric, Lyric Theater.…
People have told me that one of the main things about New Orleans drummers in a dance band, they use a little more bass drum and keep that bass drum moving out.
